title: Yumi and the Nightmare Painter
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: A temple ritualist whose duty is to keep spirits at bay and a struggling painter with a strange gift find their lives linked in an unusual way. A standalone fantasy with a romantic heart and a dreamlike setting.
readIf: you like a gentle, imaginative standalone fantasy with a romance and a sense of wonder.
skipIf: you want large-scale battles, because this one stays small and character-focused.

pairings.reason: A sibling standalone from the same author with a similar fairy-tale voice and a more whimsical quest.
A magical romance with a prickly heroine and an odd, charming partnership at its core.
Equally atmospheric, with beautiful imagery and a love story shaped by magic.
